page_title: RBL 3-1 HOF | RB Leipzig v Hoffenheim 16/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+6' A goal, which was scored by Emil Forsberg (RB Leipzig), was disallowed due to offside.
90+5' Confusion here but it seems that referee Robert Schroder has changed his mind following the VAR review and downgraded the red card shown to Florian Grillitsch (Hoffenheim) to a yellow.

90+4' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Florian Grillitsch (Hoffenheim), but referee Robert Schroder must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
90+3' Florian Grillitsch (Hoffenheim) makes a tackle on his opponent and is shown a harsh red card by the referee!
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Substitution. Pavel Kaderabek is replaced by Stanley Nsoki (Hoffenheim).

88' Nice individual effort by Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig). He gets all the way to the goalkeeper, produces a strike towards the roof of the net, but Oliver Baumann does a good job to anticipate the direction of the ball and keeps it out with a save.
85' David Raum (RB Leipzig) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

85' Fabio Carvalho (RB Leipzig) latches onto a cross into the box from the wing and gets in a header. It went well towards the goal, but it was blocked by one of the defenders. The ball goes behind for a corner. RB Leipzig will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
84' Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) did his best to latch onto a through ball, but it was too strong. The ball goes out of play and Hoffenheim will have a goal kick.
83' It's time for a substitution. Castello Lukeba (RB Leipzig) comes on in place of Mohamed Simakan.
83' Marco Rose has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Fabio Carvalho (RB Leipzig) replacing Xavi Simons.
83' Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Lois Openda.
81' Lukas Klostermann (RB Leipzig) is booked by the referee.
80' Robert Schroder blows his whistle after Lukas Klostermann (RB Leipzig) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Hoffenheim are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
78' Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
75' Pellegrino Matarazzo has decided to substitute Anton Stach and he is replaced by Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim).
75' It is time for a substitution. Kevin Akpoguma (Hoffenheim) is on for Ozan Kabak.
74' 3 - 1 Goal! 3:1. The ball rebounds to Mohamed Simakan (RB Leipzig) after a melee in the box, and he easily beats the keeper from close range.

74' Oliver Baumann showed himself in a good light as he made a terrific save from a close-range effort by Emil Forsberg (RB Leipzig). The shot was well directed to the top of the net, but the goalkeeper parried the ball onto the bar.
74' The referee awards a corner and David Raum (RB Leipzig) goes over to take it.

73' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) produced a promising shot towards the right side of the goal after his wonderful solo run, but Oliver Baumann thwarted him with a fabulous save and the score remains the same. The linesman points to the corner flag, RB Leipzig are going to take it.
72' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) has a crack at goal from inside the box, but the defender somehow makes the block to deny him.

71' 2 - 1 Goal! Lois Openda displays great vision and sends a pass to Emil Forsberg (RB Leipzig), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the top left corner. The score is 2:1.
69' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ihlas Bebou trots off the pitch and is replaced by Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim).

68' Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) wastes a great chance from the resulting corner. He times his header superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross, but can't aim better than into the middle of the goal, straight into the arms of the goalkeeper.
67' There's an opportunity for Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
67' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.
66' Substitution. Christoph Baumgartner walks off the pitch and Emil Forsberg (RB Leipzig) comes on as a substitute.
63' David Raum (RB Leipzig) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
62' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) picks up a caution.
62' Ozan Kabak (Hoffenheim) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.
60' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.

59' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) attempted to send a defence-splitting pass into space where Lois Openda was lurking. It could have put him one-on-one with the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players somehow manages to avert the threat.
58' The substitution has been made. Kevin Kampl (RB Leipzig) has replaced Amadou Haidara.
57' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
56' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) takes a wild swing at a rebound from mid-range and it goes well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Hoffenheim will have a goal kick.
56' Two players stand over the free kick. Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) eventually steps forward, but his attempt from the edge of the box is blocked by the defensive wall.
54' Poor challenge! Kevin Vogt (Hoffenheim) is penalised for tripping and Robert Schroder blows his whistle. RB Leipzig have a free kick from a promising distance.
51' Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
50' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) unleashes a tremendous shot from distance, but it crashes against the left post! If it had flown more to the right it would have been a cracker!
48' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
46' Pellegrino Matarazzo has made a change at the break. Florian Grillitsch has come on in place of Robert Skov (Hoffenheim).
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' Robert Schroder blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+3' Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Robert Schroder has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' Mohamed Simakan (RB Leipzig) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
43' Looks like Mohamed Simakan (RB Leipzig) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.

42' 1 - 1 Superbly taken set piece! Robert Skov takes the free kick and sends a cross into the six-yard box. Ozan Kabak (Hoffenheim) flicks the ball lightly with his head towards the middle of the goal. Janis Blaswich can't react quickly enough and the score changes to 1:1.

41' Ozan Kabak (Hoffenheim) reacts well and displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick. He jumps high and produces a header which goes well wide of the right post.
40' Amadou Haidara (RB Leipzig) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Robert Schroder had an easy-decision to make.
38' David Raum (RB Leipzig) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.

38' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. RB Leipzig have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

37' What a save from Oliver Baumann! Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save to keep it out.

36' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Oliver Baumann makes a great save to stop the effort going into the top right corner.
34' 1 - 0 Goal! The rebound fell to Lukas Klostermann (RB Leipzig) and he fired home from close range. The score is 1:0.
34' Mohamed Simakan (RB Leipzig) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
34' John Anthony Brooks (Hoffenheim) is able to continue to play.
33' John Anthony Brooks (Hoffenheim) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
33' John Anthony Brooks (Hoffenheim) brings an opponent down and Robert Schroder interrupts the game. A free kick has been awarded to RB Leipzig.
32' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the middle of the goal, but Janis Blaswich is well positioned to make a comfortable save.

30' Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the middle of the goal. However, Oliver Baumann anticipates the shot and makes a decent save.
29' Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig) shows brilliant individual skill to find some space and tries his luck from long range, but the shot flies high over the bar.
27' David Raum (RB Leipzig) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
26' The resulting corner, taken by Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig), comes to nothing. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to RB Leipzig.

25' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the middle of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
25' Hoffenheim get a corner.

24' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate. Hoffenheim win a corner.
22' Robert Skov (Hoffenheim) latches onto a brilliant cross and fires the ball towards goal, but his shot goes high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig will have a goal kick.
20' Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig) finds his teammate inside the box with a sweet pass. However, Christoph Baumgartner wasn't able to finish and lost the ball.
19' Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance.
17' Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) makes a run into the box in an attempt to get onto a long through ball, but one of the opponents comes up with a vital clearance.

17' He should have scored! Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot towards the middle of the goal is pretty weak and Oliver Baumann makes an easy save.

13' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) beats a defender on the edge of the box then bends in an effort at goal, but his radar is way off and the ball sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Hoffenheim will have a goal kick.
13' A clever short pass gives Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball well wide of the left post.
11' Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
9' Some patient build-up play from RB Leipzig as they look to unlock the defence.
7' Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
6' RB Leipzig quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
5' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to RB Leipzig.
4' Robert Schroder blows his whistle and it's Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.

2' Xavi Simons floats a good corner into the box that Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig) gets on the end of, but his effort on goal scorches just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Hoffenheim.
2' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
1' The first half has just begun.
The attendance is 40000.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Hoffenheim will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Robert Schroder.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
